messages:
maria: Quick sync: assessor engagement scheduled (2025-12-02). Need to finalize retest acceptance criteria + artifact packaging format. Also confirm we9ll avoid granting KMS decrypts.

kevin: Confirm dates and scope?

maria: 2025-12-02 09:00 -> 2025-12-03 18:00 UTC. Scope = staging, integration test cluster, vault-proxy calls, auth flows. No prod.

anita: On KMS: we9ll provide sealed ciphertext blobs + a controlled signing endpoint. No raw decrypt. If assessors request verification, they call `POST /kms-proxy/sign` with CSR-like payload and we return signature; all calls logged.

infra-oncall: I9ll create ephemeral OKTA roles scoped to `staging/*` and `kms-proxy:sign` only. TTL = 3h by default. Command: `sudo ./grant-temp --user assessor:acme --roles assessor:staging --ttlhours 3`.

kevin: Evidence bag format: gzipped tar with top-level `audit/`, `configs/`, `objects/`, `manifest.csv`. Manifest columns: path, sha256, size_bytes, type, timestamp. Keep manifests CSV to make parsing simple.

maria: Agree CSV is easier. Add `owner` column for who exported it and `export_tool_version`.

anita: KMS proxy log fields: ts, request_id, principal, operation, key_fingerprint, payload_hash, response_code, authorization_hint. Include `trace_id` if available to tie into APM.

infra-oncall: I'll enable CloudTrail + internal audit stream export for the window. Retention for these artifacts set to 120 days for legal team. Put final export under `s3://sec-handoff/acme-20251202/` and create presigned GET/PUT for assesors (GET only). Placeholder URL: `https://presigned.redwood/example/acme-20251202`

kevin: Triage rules for retest acceptance: critical/major (CVSS >= 9 or exploit found) = block retest until fixed and verified; high (7-8.9) = must have mitigation + test plan; medium/low = schedule. We'll codify this in triage doc.

maria: Add requirement: for any vulnerability touching KMS or auth paths, include `repro_steps.md` + `patch_diff.patch` in `configs/` so assessors can validate retest.

anita: For configuration snapshots: include `iam_roles_before.json`, `iam_roles_after.json`, `kms_key_policy_before.json`, `kms_key_policy_after.json`. Ensure these are canonical JSON exports and included in manifest.

engsec-bot: calendar event created: "Assessor: Acme - Staging" 2025-12-02 09:00 -> 2025-12-03 18:00 UTC.

infra-oncall: Dry-run proposed tomorrow 08:00 UTC. I will test KMS proxy logging, presigned URL generation, and a small sample artifact upload.

kevin: I9ll run audit extraction script and push sample `audit_sample.json` into `s3://sec-handoff/acme-20251202/sample/` for review. Example jq: `jq -c '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="GetObject")' trail.json > objects/s3-get-events.ndjson`

maria: Good. Also define mapping between assessor IDs and OKTA principals so `authorization_hint` is human-readable.

infra-oncall: noted. I9ll post the runbook link and the presigned URL in this thread when ready.

maria: Thanks. Final action items: kevin -> packaging schema + sample manifest; infra-oncall -> presigned path + ephemeral roles; anita -> KMS proxy logging schema & test signing endpoint; me -> triage severity doc and retest gate criteria. Dry-run tomorrow 08:00 UTC.

kevin: I9ll upload sample tar by EOD today.

anita: Will run proxy log verification script during dry-run.

maria: Perfect. :white_check_mark:
